prompt: Write a TypeScript function that finds the first duplicate in an array. Include the final code and explain time and space complexity.
You have an array of 1,000,000 integers. You need to find whether any two values sum to a target. Compare a brute-force solution with an efficient solution and explain the tradeoffs.
You inherit a TypeScript repository with authentication, an API server, a database, and a React frontend. Describe how you would safely investigate the repository before modifying code.
An AI coding agent changed three files, ran the test suite, and 7 tests failed. Describe the exact loop the agent should follow to diagnose, fix, retest, and verify the changes.
Explain how an AI coding agent should prevent API keys and other secrets from being exposed while inspecting and modifying a repository.
Implement a TypeScript debounce function with correct typing. Explain edge cases and provide an example.
A Node.js API works locally but returns 500 errors in production. Give a systematic debugging process that avoids guessing.

Build a responsive hero section and a 3-column feature grid in semantic HTML and CSS. It must stack to one column on mobile, use CSS custom properties for colour and spacing, and keep keyboard focus visible.

Implement a fixed-timestep game loop for a 2D game. Physics must run at a constant rate regardless of frame time, rendering must interpolate between updates, and a long stall must not trigger a spiral of death.
Explain how a 3D model-space vertex becomes a screen pixel. Name every coordinate space and matrix, and say where a vertex can be lost along the way.

Review this endpoint: it builds a SQL query with an f-string from a request parameter, returns the raw exception text to the client, and has no authentication check. Explain each vulnerability and the fix.

A pagination helper returns 9 items for page 1 when the page size is 10, and the last page repeats an item. Describe how you would reproduce, isolate and fix it, including the boundary cases you would test.
